en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a grand alpine hotel building surrounded by dense coniferous forest. The hotel has a steep, decorative roof with dormer windows and a central tower-like section. A large sign on the roof reads "HOTEL REGINA DEL BOSCO". In the foreground are trees, a path or road, and rustic fencing. At the bottom margin there is a caption identifying the hotel and location.
